title: ASCII background
note: An ascii.rest scene behind the workspace. The dark theme uses the scene's own palette; the light theme offers ink (hues kept, lightness mirrored) or duotone (a two-colour print).
placementNote: Choose what happens to the overflow, then which edge to keep. The picture always scales at the scene's own ratio, never stretched.
lightModeNote: Only the light theme uses this. Ink keeps the scene's hues and mirrors its lightness; duotone maps each cell's luminance between paper and ink, so it reads as a print.
regionsNote: How much of the picture each region lets through. 0 is the host's own opaque surface, 1 is the skin's default.
scrimNote: Fades one edge of the picture towards the ground so the composer and the sidebar have a quiet base to sit on.
pauseOnBlurNote: Stop drawing while the window is in the background, and resume on return.
splashNote: On a cold start the current scene fills the window, then fades once the interface is ready. Switching the skin on mid-session does not play it.
